entries.name: Tended Lampfruit

counterPressure.note: The identity is a resource.economy capability with no raw-stat weight of its own; the raw-stat lines (mending low plus a narrow might slot) stay well under the grafted rung's rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: Every fruit it drops is already counted. Whoever keeps this orchard's books never once seems to blink.
entries.notes: Role armament-primary (muzzle), rung band 30, axis economy. Compound name: adjective 'Tended' from themeAdjectivePools['hollow-orchard'], Base noun 'Lampfruit' from uniqueSetSeedPools['hollow-orchard'] (atomic seed, used whole per naming.v1.json rule 2a, never decomposed). baseType item.plant-muzzle-a-005 ('Lobbed Gourd', seedpod, band a) is an existing plant armament-primary base type; a fruit-flinging muzzle repurposed to also harvest sun quietly. atom.sunbloom and atom.mending are both outside classes.v1.json's excludedFamilies.global, so both bind today.

entries.name: Vigilant Bole

counterPressure.note: Retribution is an on-hit reflect capability, not a raw magnitude; the raw-stat total (fortitude low plus a narrow vitality slot) sits well under the cultivated rung's higher rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: It does not swing first. It has never needed to.
entries.notes: Role core-guard (stem), rung band 30, axis offense. Compound name: adjective 'Vigilant' from themeAdjectivePools['hollow-orchard'], Base noun 'Bole' from the core-guard.plant noun pool (any noun pool is open to a unique partition per words.v1.json poolAccess.uniquePartition). baseType item.plant-stem-b-007 ('Dense Trunk', heartwood, band b). atom.retribution and atom.fortitude are both outside classes.v1.json's excludedFamilies.global.

entries.name: Cloistered Sheath

counterPressure.note: atom.warded is a shield.grant capability, not a raw magnitude; the raw-stat total (fortitude low plus a narrow vitality slot) stays well under the grafted rung's rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: Grown around the shoulder like a vow taken and never once broken.
entries.notes: Role ward-array (sheath), rung band 30, axis survivability. Compound name: adjective 'Cloistered' from themeAdjectivePools['hollow-orchard'], Base noun 'Sheath' from the ward-array.plant noun pool. baseType item.plant-sheath-a-002 ('Papery Peel', fibre, band a). Deliberately NOT atom.warding: classes.v1.json excludedFamilies.global flags it as legal only at commander/match-owner scope (G8), so a per-item copy on a body role would bind nowhere. atom.warded is its own shield.grant family and is explicitly carved out as unaffected by that exclusion, so it carries the identity instead; the raw defense line uses atom.fortitude.

entries.name: Votive Aculeus

counterPressure.note: Mesmerizing is a status.apply control capability, not a raw magnitude; the raw-stat total (might low plus a narrow ferocity slot) sits well under the cultivated rung's rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: The censer never smokes loudly. It only ever holds your attention a little too long.
entries.notes: Role armament-secondary (thorn), rung band 30, axis control. Compound name: adjective 'Votive' from themeAdjectivePools['hollow-orchard'], Base noun 'Aculeus' from the armament-secondary.plant noun pool. baseType item.plant-thorn-a-005 ('Perfumed Aculeus', censer, band a) — its own censer class is exactly what makes a hushed, hypnotic capability read as native rather than bolted on. Deliberately NOT atom.entangling for the control identity: classes.v1.json excludedFamilies.global flags it as needing a Unity CC branch for 'kelp' that does not exist yet. atom.mesmerizing is not on that list and carries the same control-axis intent (denial, not damage) without the dead binding.

entries.flavor: One drop clears the throat of everything but the quiet.
entries.notes: Role jewel-major (pollen), rung band 30, axis utility. entries.name: Bough of Dawn

counterPressure.note: The on-hit light proc is a capability, not a raw magnitude; the raw-stat total (fortitude low plus a narrow might slot) stays well under the grafted rung's rolled baseline.

entries.flavor: Whatever brushes past it in the dark leaves a little less dark behind.
entries.notes: Role mantle (canopy), rung band 30, axis offense. Of-construct name: Base 'Bough' from the mantle.plant noun pool, Concept 'Dawn' from conceptPools['hollow-orchard']. baseType item.plant-canopy-b-004 ('Ancient Bough', heartwood, band b) shares its own head noun, deliberately. The element is 'light' per themes.v1.json's elementAffinity for hollow-orchard, kept deliberately understated (a mote, not a blaze) per the theme's own avoid-list against loud, showy radiance. atom.searing-strike takes a variant element per seed-contract.md §10's affix-family shape and is used exactly as the exemplar demonstrates; atom.fortitude is outside classes.v1.json's excludedFamilies.global.
